title: Cookie Policy
summary: This page explains which cookies or similar browser storage technologies the web app uses, which ones are optional, and how you can change consent at any time.

status.unavailable: Analytics does not run in this app or build, so there is nothing to choose.

whatTheyAre.title: What cookies and similar technologies are
whatTheyAre.copy: Cookies are small text files stored by your browser. This web app also uses browser storage for app preferences and offline-first data saved directly on your device.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary and device-local storage
necessary.copy: The app uses browser storage that is necessary to preserve your own settings and local data on the device you use.

items.language: Language preference and similar technical settings needed to keep the interface usable.
items.consent: The analytics consent choice itself, so the site remembers whether optional analytics is allowed or rejected.
items.offlineData: Favorites, saved teams, saved enemies, recent items, and worker settings that stay local to your browser unless you export them.

analytics.title: Optional analytics cookies
analytics.copy: Nothing measures you before you choose. If you accept analytics, the site loads a Google Tag Manager container and Google Analytics 4, which may create analytics cookies such as _ga and _ga_<id> to distinguish visits and measure aggregate usage.

items.container: The Google Tag Manager container loads only after you accept, so the tags it manages load only after you accept too.
items.cookies: These analytics identifiers are optional and are not loaded until you grant consent.
items.purpose: They are used only to measure traffic and understand which pages or screens are useful.
items.noAds: The site does not use this analytics setup to turn on advertising or personalized ads.
items.clarity: Microsoft Clarity measures how pages are actually used. It is delivered by that container, so it too loads only after you accept.
items.cloudflare: Cloudflare Web Analytics measures page-level traffic without cookies. It is added by the network in front of the site, so it is present whatever you choose here.

duration.title: How long storage may remain
duration.copy: Storage duration depends on the technology and your own browser behavior.

items.necessary: Device-local preferences and saved app data remain until you delete them in the app or clear browser storage.
items.analytics: Google Analytics cookies may remain for practical periods that can extend up to two years, subject to browser behavior and Google's current configuration.
items.browser: You can also remove cookies and storage earlier through your browser controls.

manageConsent.title: How to manage consent
manageConsent.copy: You can accept or reject optional analytics below, from the banner the site shows once you move between screens, or later on the Settings page. Rejecting analytics loads nothing and changes nothing in the app.

browserControls.title: Browser controls
browserControls.copy: Most browsers let you inspect, block, or delete cookies and site storage. Clearing browser data may also remove language settings, offline data, and consent preferences saved by this app.

related.title: Related pages
related.copy: Use the links below to read the broader privacy notice, the terms of service, or reopen the app settings.
